name: 2-Ethylhexyl acetate
description: 2-Ethylhexyl acetate (CAS 103-09-3 ) is a slow-evaporating ester solvent used across coatings, adhesives, and personal care formulations. Its low evaporation rate makes it a practical choice for extending open time. This chemical is ideal for improving film formation in solvent-based systems. It also functions as a fragrance ingredient and emollient carrier in various cosmetic applications and industrial processes. In industrial coatings and printing inks, this ester controls solvent release to reduce surface defects such as blushing and pinholes. It is particularly effective in high-solids and alkyd formulations. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers use it to adjust viscosity and working time in solvent-borne systems. In personal care, it acts as a lightweight carrier and skin-conditioning agent for consumers. It is commonly found in formulations such as sunscreens, color cosmetics, and leave-on products. Metalworking formulators incorporate it as a coupling solvent and lubricity modifier in cutting fluids. The product is also used in rust-preventive compounds to ensure long-term protection. It is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities, with bulk tanker options available for larger volumes. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering for industrial and coatings applications.
